title: Showcase task: Rename a function across a small package
summary: Negative control. Rename calc_total to compute_order_total everywhere in a five-file package and keep tests passing.
description: Pre-registered 2026-10-10, spec hash 26384af9ebfc49578482c748e295a8014bb71157978b855fe28563efec0c6248. 5 paired trials per arm. A capable model solves this without outside help, and no catalogue component targets it. Any treatment advantage beyond noise points to a placebo or prompt effect; extra treatment-arm tokens or tool calls measure the overhead of searching when nothing useful exists.

side_effects: setup writes a fresh workspace and a hidden ground-truth directory
evaluate.py runs agent-written code in a subprocess with a timeout

examples: Set up trial 1 of showcase_task_control_rename_function_refactor and score the agent's workspace
Print the run plan for this task: python3 showcase_eval.py .

review.notes: Evaluator self-test proves a known-good output passes and a known-bad output fails.
